categories.label: City Water Systems
categories.intro: Municipal water in the Twin Cities is treated and safe, but it typically carries hardness minerals plus chlorine or chloramine disinfectant. These systems soften and filter every tap in the house.

categories.label: Well Water Systems
categories.intro: Private wells in Minnesota commonly carry iron, manganese and hardness, and in some areas hydrogen sulfide. Final well configuration depends on a water test — we review that with you by phone.

categories.label: Drinking Water / Reverse Osmosis
categories.intro: Point-of-use reverse osmosis treats the water you drink and cook with at a dedicated kitchen faucet. Included free with any whole-home system, or installed on its own.

categories.label: Optional Add-Ons
categories.intro: Protection layers recommended for most well-water installs.

systems.name: Whole Home Filtration & Softening System
systems.image_alt: MSP Pure Water whole-home filtration and softening system: single media tank cutaway showing carbon, softening resin and polishing gravel, with brine tank
systems.for: Twin Cities homes on municipal water that want soft water and no chlorine taste at every faucet, in one compact footprint.

stages.title: Jacobi catalytic carbon tank
stages.text: The Jacobi catalytic carbon tank treats chlorine, chloramine, taste, odor and harmful organic contaminants first.

stages.title: 10% crosslinked resin
stages.text: 10% crosslinked resin removes the calcium and magnesium that cause hard water.

stages.title: Polishing gravel
stages.text: Polishing gravel supports the media bed for even flow and maximum contact time.

stages.title: MSP ceramic disc valve
stages.text: The MSP ceramic disc valve automatically backwashes and regenerates the system. No effort from you.

included: Reverse osmosis drinking-water system (tank or tankless)
systems.what_it_does: Softens and filters every drop of water entering your home. One high-capacity media tank handles hardness, chlorine, chloramine, taste and odor, so every faucet, shower and appliance gets treated water.
leads: 48,000-grain softening capacity
28 GPM system flow, no pressure loss
MSP ceramic disc valve with 72-hour memory backup
NSF-certified media, lifetime warranty

systems.name: Dual Tank Whole Home Filtration System
systems.image_alt: Dual Tank Whole Home Water Filtration System: softening resin tank and carbon filtration tank cutaways with brine tank
systems.for: Larger households and heavy water use: carbon filtration and softening each get their own full-strength tank.

stages.title: Jacobi catalytic carbon tank
stages.text: Tank one: the Jacobi catalytic carbon tank treats chlorine, chloramine, taste and odor.

stages.title: 10% crosslinked resin tank
stages.text: Tank two: high-capacity 10% crosslinked resin removes hardness minerals.

stages.title: Polishing gravel
stages.text: Polishing gravel in both tanks keeps flow even and prevents channeling.

stages.title: MSP ceramic disc valve
stages.text: A single MSP ceramic disc valve controls both tanks and backwashes them automatically.

included: Reverse osmosis drinking-water system (tank or tankless)
systems.what_it_does: Gives the Jacobi catalytic carbon tank and the 10% crosslinked resin tank their own dedicated high-capacity vessels. Each media bed works at full strength, ideal for larger households and heavy water use.
leads: The only dual-tank system designed to self-clean the carbon tank
30 GPM valve flow for high-demand homes
Dedicated media beds last longer and filter deeper
NSF-certified media, lifetime warranty

systems.name: Whole Home Complete Salt-Free Filtration System
systems.image_alt: Whole Home Complete Salt-Free Filtration System: carbon filtration tank cutaway and salt-free conditioning tank
systems.for: Homeowners who want whole-home carbon filtration and scale protection with no salt bags, no brine discharge and no regeneration cycles.

stages.title: Jacobi catalytic carbon tank
stages.text: The Jacobi catalytic carbon tank removes chlorine, chloramine, chemicals and odors from all your water.

stages.title: Salt-free conditioning tank
stages.text: The salt-free conditioning tank transforms hardness minerals so they can no longer form scale. It does not remove hardness the way 10% crosslinked resin does.

stages.title: Polishing gravel
stages.text: Polishing gravel supports even water distribution through the media.

stages.title: Clack in/out head
stages.text: Zero electricity, zero drain line, zero salt. The simplest system to own.

systems.what_it_does: Whole-home carbon filtration plus salt-free scale conditioning. No salt bags, no brine discharge, no regeneration cycles. Keeps healthy minerals in your water while stopping them from sticking to pipes and appliances.
leads: No salt, no brine discharge
Keeps beneficial calcium and magnesium in your water
Protects water heaters, dishwashers and plumbing from scale
Lowest-maintenance system in our lineup

systems.name: Dual Tank Well Water Whole Home Filtration System
systems.image_alt: MSP Pure Water dual tank well-water system: softening resin tank and Katalox Light media tank cutaways with brine tank
systems.for: Minnesota well homes dealing with iron staining, manganese and hard water, treated without chemicals.

stages.title: MSP AIO ceramic disc valve
stages.text: The MSP AIO ceramic disc valve creates a pressurized air pocket that naturally oxidizes iron and manganese. No chemicals added.

stages.title: Katalox Light media
stages.text: Katalox Light media traps the oxidized particles and boosts pH for better-tasting water.

stages.title: 10% crosslinked resin tank
stages.text: A dedicated 10% crosslinked resin tank removes calcium and magnesium hardness.

stages.title: Polishing gravel and automatic backwash
stages.text: Polishing gravel keeps flow even, and both tanks self-clean with automatic backwashing.

included: Reverse osmosis drinking-water system (tank or tankless)
systems.note: Final well-water configuration may depend on water test results. We review testing as part of your phone consultation.
systems.what_it_does: Treats the two biggest well-water problems, iron and hardness, chemical-free, and handles manganese along the way. Air-oxidation technology plus Katalox Light media stop staining while a dedicated 10% crosslinked resin tank softens your water.
leads: Chemical-free iron and manganese treatment
Self-cleaning Katalox Light media, low maintenance
30 GPM valve flow built for well pumps
NSF-certified media, lifetime warranty

systems.name: Iron & Sulfur Treatment System
systems.image_alt: Iron & Sulfur Treatment System: hydrogen peroxide injection panel, holding tank, carbon and softening tanks
systems.for: The system for rotten-egg sulfur odor, and for wells with heavier iron loads where air oxidation alone is not enough.

stages.title: Hydrogen peroxide injection panel
stages.text: The injection panel doses hydrogen peroxide the moment water enters your home, instantly breaking down iron and sulfur.

stages.title: Jacobi catalytic carbon tank
stages.text: The oxidized particles are captured by a dedicated Jacobi catalytic carbon tank. The peroxide itself is consumed and filtered out, never reaching your faucets.

stages.title: 10% crosslinked resin tank
stages.text: A dedicated 10% crosslinked resin tank removes hardness for fully softened water.

stages.title: MSP ceramic disc valve and polishing gravel
stages.text: The MSP ceramic disc valve backwashes captured contaminants down the drain; polishing gravel keeps flow even through both tanks.

included: Reverse osmosis drinking-water system (tank or tankless)
systems.note: Final well-water configuration may depend on water test results. We review testing as part of your phone consultation.
systems.what_it_does: Our most powerful well-water solution, and the one we install for rotten-egg sulfur odor. Hydrogen peroxide oxidation destroys even severe iron and sulfur problems at the point of entry, then a dedicated Jacobi catalytic carbon tank and a 10% crosslinked resin tank finish the job.
leads: Handles the most severe iron and rotten-egg sulfur conditions
Stronger than air oxidation, works where other systems fail
Consistent chemical feed with dedicated holding tank
Complete package: oxidation + filtration + softening

systems.name: HW800 AlkaPro Tankless Reverse Osmosis
systems.badge: Included Free With Any Whole-Home System
systems.image_alt: HW800 AlkaPro tankless reverse osmosis unit, white with black front panel, next to a chrome drinking-water faucet
systems.for: Kitchens where under-sink space matters and you want drinking water treated on demand, with minerals added back for taste.

stages.title: 7-stage high-precision filtration
stages.text: An ultra-fine 0.0001-micron spiral-flow RO membrane with pre- and post-filtration.

stages.title: Dissolved solids, chlorine and organics reduced
stages.text: Reduces total dissolved solids, chlorine and everyday organic contaminants for clean-tasting water.

stages.title: Alkaline remineralization
stages.text: Built-in remineralization adds beneficial minerals back for great taste and balanced pH.

stages.title: Auto flush, DIY filters
stages.text: Auto RO flush keeps the membrane clean automatically; filters twist out and twist in.

systems.what_it_does: Purified, alkaline drinking water on demand, straight from a dedicated faucet at your sink. No storage tank, 70% less under-sink space, and water treated the moment you ask for it.
leads: 800 GPD capacity
2:1 low drain ratio, less water to drain
Alkaline remineralization for taste
DIY filter changes, no service calls needed

systems.name: Traditional Tank Reverse Osmosis System
systems.badge: Included Free With Any Whole-Home System
systems.image_alt: Tank reverse osmosis system: multi-stage filter bank with pressurized storage tank and chrome faucet
systems.for: The proven under-sink configuration: purified water stored in a pressurized tank and delivered instantly when you open the faucet.

stages.title: Multi-stage prefiltration
stages.text: Strips sediment, chlorine and dissolved contaminants before the RO membrane.

stages.title: RO membrane
stages.text: The RO membrane rejects 94–99% of total dissolved solids.

stages.title: Pressurized steel tank
stages.text: A food-grade butyl bladder inside the steel tank keeps purified water pressurized and fresh.

stages.title: Instant delivery
stages.text: Water is stored ready to pour: instant flow for glasses, pots and coffee makers.

systems.what_it_does: The proven multi-stage RO setup: purified water is produced continuously, stored in a pressurized steel tank, and delivered instantly the second you open the faucet.
leads: 94–99% TDS rejection
Instant delivery from pressurized storage
Corrosion-resistant steel shell, heavy-duty base
Compact footprint fits under most kitchen sinks

systems.name: Pre-System Sediment Filter
systems.image_alt: Pre-system sediment filter with blue housing and black cap
systems.for: The first line of defense on a well. Captures sand, silt, dirt and rust before they reach the resin, media and valves downstream.
included: Installed ahead of your whole-home system

systems.name: Whole-Home UV Purifier
systems.image_alt: Whole-house ultraviolet purifier: stainless steel chamber with UV lamps, quartz sleeves, ballast and mounting clamps
systems.for: An additional disinfection barrier for well water. UV light inactivates microorganisms as water flows through a stainless chamber. It does not remove iron, sediment or dissolved chemicals, so it is installed after filtration.
